response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, but lacks the required C++ experience on Windows systems (only mentions limited C/C++ work). Additionally, there is no evidence of domain expertise in capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking, which are mandatory for this role.
strengths: Strong general software engineering background with experience in diverse technologies and full-stack development
Proven ability to learn and adapt to new tools and frameworks quickly
Experience with performance optimization and low-latency systems
concerns: Lacks 5–10 years of hands-on C++ development on Windows platform (mandatory requirement)
No demonstrated experience in capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domains
Limited exposure to SQL Server/Oracle (mentions SQL/MongoDB but no specific financial databases)
